env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[!symlink] skip 'symlink unavailable'
symlink m/link.go -> ../outside/real.go
cd m

logos build ./...
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/run-before.txt
cp ../outside/real.go $WORK/outside-real.orig
cp main.go $WORK/main.orig

# A symlinked source must be refused: renaming link.go would corrupt the
# file outside the module, and the emitted patch must not describe it.
! logos next --fix
stderr 'link.go'
cmp main.go $WORK/main.orig
! exists main.lgo
exists link.go
! exists link.lgo
cmp ../outside/real.go $WORK/outside-real.orig
! exists next_tasks.json
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/run-before.txt

# A plan path that is a symlink must be refused: the patch's plan change
# would have to be applied through the link into main.go, and --ai-patch
# would write the plan through the link directly. --fix writes nothing
# itself, so its refusal protects the emitted patch, not the files.
rm link.go
symlink next_tasks.json -> main.go
! logos next --ai-patch
stderr 'next_tasks.json'
! logos next --fix
stderr 'next_tasks.json'
exists next_tasks.json
cmp next_tasks.json $WORK/main.orig
cmp main.go $WORK/main.orig
! exists main.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nextsymlink

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hi")
}

-- outside/real.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func Real(name string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("hello %s", name)
}
